listing_copy.app_card_subtitle: Automate sold-out sorting, visibility rules, and stock alerts
listing_copy.app_introduction: Keep available products visible first with automated sorting, visibility controls, and stock alerts.
listing_copy.app_details: VSN Stock Down Sort keeps available products ahead of sold-out items and gives merchants control over collection sorting, exclusions, pinning, product and variant visibility, automation, alerts, analytics, commerce-context rules, and integrations. Merchants can enable collections individually, run sorting on demand, restore previous sort behavior, and choose capabilities by plan.
feature_list: Push sold-out products below available items automatically
Re-sort collections when inventory or products change
Exclude, pin, and manually sort products in collections
Hide or republish products and sold-out variants automatically
Schedule automation and send low-stock email or Slack alerts
Apply inventory rules across locations, markets, and B2B catalogs
Review activity history, analytics, and CSV exports
Connect external workflows with secure API integrations

reviewer_instructions.test_store_requirement: Use a Shopify development store with the Live app installed. No external service credentials are required for the core review path.
reviewer_instructions.test_data_requirement: Use or create a manual collection containing at least one available product and one sold-out product. A restockable product is helpful for re-sort verification.
steps: Install or open VSN | Stock Down Sort and confirm the app redirects into the embedded app UI without a web error.
Open Plans and select Starter from Shopify-hosted pricing. On a development store owned by the same Partner organization, the paid plan is selected at no charge and returns to /app.
Open Collections, enable the test collection, and run Sort now.
Open the collection in Shopify and confirm available products remain ahead of sold-out products.
Return to the app and use Disable & restore to confirm the previous Shopify collection sort behavior can be restored.
Open collection rules and verify exclusions and manual sorting controls are interactive.
Use Growth or a higher plan when reviewing visibility automation, scheduled automation, Slack alerts, multi-location rules, analytics, commerce-context rules, or API integrations.
Confirm plan changes can be initiated from the Plans page without reinstalling the app.
Confirm Help center/support is reachable from the app navigation.

demo_screencast.objective: Demonstrate onboarding and the merchant-facing features described in the listing without exposing credentials or personal data.
scenes: Install/open the Live app and land in the embedded UI.
Open Shopify-hosted plan selection and select a development-store no-charge plan.
Enable a collection and run Sort now.
Show the resulting available-first / sold-out-last collection order.
Show exclusions, pinning, visibility automation, schedules, and alerts.
Show Help center and return to the app home.
